Name: Linus as Sans
Author: Fliren
Description:
This mod replace Linus's Overworld sprite and Portrait with Sans from Undertale

[u]Installation:
[/u]
1. Go to your Stardew Valley's folder.
2. Open the folder called "Content".
3. Open the zip file. Inside of it you'll find two other folders: "Characters" and "Portraits"
4. Drag the file from Characters into your Stardew Valley's Characters folder. Do the same to the other folder.
5. Launche the Game and Enjoy!
